author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕರ್ತವ್ಯ ಪಾಲನೆಯೆ ಧರ್ಮವೆಂದೆನಿಸುವುದು
ಕರ್ತನಾಗಿಹೆ ನೀನು ಧರ್ಮಸಾಧನೆಗೆ
ಅರ್ಥವಾಗಲು ನಿನಗೆ ನಿನಜನ್ಮ ಕಾರಣವು
ವರ್ತಿಸುವೆ ಸತ್ಯದಲಿ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Keeping to one’s duty is what counts as dharma;
you are the doer, for the achievement of dharma;
so that you may understand the reason for your birth,
you will act in truth, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Dharma is, first of all, doing one’s duty. We are the agents through whom dharma is fulfilled, and acting truthfully is how we come to understand why we were born.
